sources.title: Model Architecture | join16/COD-VAE | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The COD-VAE model architecture is designed to compress 3D point clouds into compact, structured latent representations suitable for generative modeling. The system transitions 3D data from the Natural Language Space (concepts like "shape" and "occupancy") into a structured Code Entity Space (latent vectors and triplanes) using a hierarchical transformer-based approach.
